t: Three things he asked to be spared on a journey
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَمِنْ كَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَمِنْ سُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
p: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi-s-safar, wa min kaʾābati-l-munqalab, wa min sūʾi-l-manẓari fi-l-māli wa-l-ahl
m: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of the journey, from the gloom of the return, and from an ugly sight in property and family.
